body:
The indent script itself hasn't changed between Vim and Neovim, so it appears likely to be some optimizations in the C side that we haven't merged over yet.

The time seems to be spent in `searchpair()`.

Neovim:

```
1              1.398612   let parlnum = searchpair('(\|{\|\[', '', ')\|}\|\]', 'nbW', "line('.') < " . (plnum - s:maxoff) . " ? dummy :" . " synIDattr(synID(line('.'), col('.'), 1), 'name')" . " =~ '\\(Comment\\|Todo\\|String\\)$'")
```

Vim:

```
1              0.147579   let parlnum = searchpair('(\|{\|\[', '', ')\|}\|\]', 'nbW', "line('.') < " . (plnum - s:maxoff) . " ? dummy :" . " synIDattr(synID(line('.'), col('.'), 1), 'name')" . " =~ '\\(Comment\\|Todo\\|String\\)$'")
```

issue.body:
The UTF-8 Japanese translation of "Word '%._s' added to %s" was missed
in 404dc5420b7cacd251d15f273bafe59ff008b9a6, which caused a segfault due
to the missing '%._s'.

Closes #5055

``` vim
:echo filter(g:, 'v:key =~ "pyindent"')
```
